'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 758
|text = The cryptic reveals where to search:<br><br>Look in the ground floor crates of houses in Falador.
|notes = Search the crates near the house east of the eastern bank in [[Falador]].
|map = {{Map|3029,3355|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Ring of wealth]] teleport to [[Falador Park]].
*[[Falador Teleport]] and run east.
*[[Skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Mining Guild]] and run into the guild and up the ladder with 60 [[Mining]].
*[[Respawn Teleport]] or [[ring of returning]] teleport with [[Falador]] as your [[respawn point]].
*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Sir Rebral]].
*[[Skull sceptre]] or [[skull sceptre (i)]] teleport, then run south-west and use the North Wall Grapple [[Agility shortcut]] (requires [[crossbow]], [[grapple]], 11 [[Agility]], 37 [[Strength]], 19 [[Ranged]]).
